description: Independently curated synthetic engineering scenarios. Requirements are predeclared in fixture, NEVER passed into retrieval. They test context sufficiency proxies, not actual AI task success.

cases.task: Implement Contextual Command for selecting one file and requesting that all files in its parent folder be moved to a destination. Handle the correction 'only the highlighted file', preview bulk effects, and obtain approval before filesystem mutation.

Implement Atmospheric Motion particle effects with the Motion Coordinator; render GPU particles efficiently and automatically reduce graphic load during gaming without losing usability or reduced-motion accessibility.
Implement Connected Branches so sibling chats can find new post-fork findings, preserve provenance and selectively adopt knowledge, without leaking private project data or permissions.

Implement CIE adaptive compaction of long chat histories, preserving canonical messages, important user decisions and blockers, and checking protected constraints before continuing. Benchmark the quality and token tradeoff.
Implement Quick Capture notes so a user can jot down an idea immediately without choosing a project or waiting for an AI response; classify the note asynchronously after saving it.

Implement orchestration of specialized parallel agents working in isolated Git worktrees with task dependencies, safe delegation and evidence-based completion; never mark an unfinished task completed from a chat message.
Implement a live Intelligence Stream with actual tool execution events and reasoning summaries. Show observed versus reported versus inferred evidence and never fabricate private internal thoughts.
Implement per-chat detailed token usage profiling for input output cached reasoning tokens, ensure accurate accounting and do not claim unmeasured savings from context compaction.
